Definition: Moph, the capital of Lower Egypt
BiblicalUsage: Moph is Memphis, the capital of Lower Egypt, named as the place where the fugitives of Israel will be buried. Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the place-name is a judgment in one word: the people who ran to Egypt for safety will find only graves there.
